name: skye-spectacle-registry
purpose: Reference-aware design patterns for cinematic product sites and MCP-assisted frontend generation.

forbiddenPatterns: Hero pages with a long left column and a disconnected image on the right
Huge paragraphs in the first viewport
Decorative images that do not explain the product, person, place, or offer
Mentioning MCP smoke tests, internal proof files, or build internals on public marketing pages
Negative letter spacing or oversized display text inside compact panels
Mobile layouts with horizontal scroll, clipped labels, or hero images pushed out of view
requiredChecks: Hero subject visible in first viewport
H1 no more than 2 lines desktop and 3 lines mobile unless intentionally editorial
Primary CTA visible in first viewport
No internal MCP/test/proof wording on public pages unless user explicitly requests developer proof copy

typography.displaySerif: Playfair Display or a similar high-contrast editorial serif
typography.labelDisplay: Bebas Neue or a compact uppercase display face
typography.body: DM Sans, Inter, or a clean system sans

patterns.title: Cinematic Command Hero
patterns.description: A first viewport built around one living subject: 3D object, founder, product, venue, or proof artifact. Copy is short and arranged around the subject.
compositionRules: Primary CTA and secondary CTA are visible without scrolling
Canvas or image subject must be fully visible on mobile
patterns.qualityGate: Screenshot first viewport on desktop and mobile before shipping.

patterns.title: Scrolling Proof Funnel
patterns.description: Pinned or staged sections that walk buyers through transformation, proof, and conversion.
compositionRules: Each stage gets one sentence and one visual/proof artifact
Use pinned sections only when the story benefits
patterns.qualityGate: Scroll through full page in browser and confirm no section traps the user.

patterns.title: Operator Proof Panel
patterns.description: A compact evidence panel showing live status, checks, metrics, receipts, and handoff state without exposing internal implementation clutter.
compositionRules: Use proof labels a client understands
Keep raw smoke-test wording out of public copy
Link deeper technical proof only for qualified/admin users
patterns.qualityGate: Public copy reads like trust evidence, not dev logs.

patterns.title: Founder Authority Scene
patterns.description: Transparent founder media, proof metrics, and editorial copy presented as a premium authority scene.
compositionRules: Founder media remains transparent and unboxed when possible
Authority claims are tied to proof or outcomes
Use editorial serif headings and compact label text
patterns.qualityGate: Founder image is visible, crisp, and not cropped awkwardly on mobile.
